---
title: "Data Sources"
---

Data sources provide initial conditions and verification data for weather forecasts. Each source wraps an `earth2studio.data` Python class and returns data as xarray DataArrays.

## Available Sources

| Constructor | Description |
|:---|:---|
| `ARCO()` | Google Analysis-Ready, Cloud-Optimized ERA5 |
| `GFS()` | NOAA Global Forecast System analysis |
| `GFS_FS()` | NOAA GFS forecast data |
| `IFS()` | ECMWF Integrated Forecasting System |
| `CDS()` | Copernicus Climate Data Store |
| `NCAR_ERA5()` | NCAR Research Data Archive ERA5 |
| `WB2ERA5()` | WeatherBench2 ERA5 (cloud-hosted on GCS) |
| `WB2Climatology()` | WeatherBench2 climatology |
| `GOES()` | GOES satellite imagery |
| `MRMS()` | Multi-Radar Multi-Sensor precipitation |
| `HRRR()` | NOAA High-Resolution Rapid Refresh analysis |
| `HRRR_FX()` | NOAA HRRR forecast data |

## Fetching Data

All data sources are callable. Pass a time (or vector of times) and variable name(s):

```julia
using Earth2Studio, Dates

ds = WB2ERA5()

# Fetch a single variable at one time
da = ds(DateTime(2024, 1, 1), "t2m")

# Fetch multiple variables at multiple times
da = ds([DateTime(2024, 1, 1), DateTime(2024, 1, 2)], ["t2m", "u10m", "v10m"])
```

## Converting to Julia Arrays

Use `fetch_data` for a one-call Julia-native result:

```julia
result = fetch_data(ds, DateTime(2024, 1, 1), ["t2m", "msl"])

result.data    # Array of values
result.dims    # e.g. (:time, :variable, :lat, :lon)
result.coords  # NamedTuple of coordinate vectors
```

Or use `xarray_to_dict` on any xarray DataArray:

```julia
da = ds(DateTime(2024, 1, 1), "t2m")
result = xarray_to_dict(da)
```

## Custom Data Sources

Construct from any `earth2studio.data` class name:

```julia
ds = DataSource("CDS"; kwargs...)
```
